svg.text: Zipper noise: gain that steps vs gain that ramps
Same fader move, same audio. The only difference is how often the gain is updated.
Phase 3 — one gain value per block
~94 updates a second at 512 samples, so the gain moves in steps. Each circle is a jump in the waveform, heard as a click.
Phase 4 — one gain value per sample
48,000 updates a second, so the gain slides. Dotted: what the host asked for each block. Solid: what SmoothedValue applies.
Offline test: a constant 1.0 is fed through the real processor, so every output sample IS the gain applied to it. One +24 dB fader move, 48 kHz, 512-sample blocks.
Biggest gain change between two adjacent samples
Time taken to reach the new gain
Fader dragged +1 dB every block: biggest step
